families.label: Transportation Equipment Manufacturing
families.definition: Production and systems integration of vehicles, mobility equipment, aerospace systems, and other transportation equipment and their major components.

capabilities.label: Motor vehicle manufacturing
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to produce and integrate road vehicles through controlled manufacturing, assembly, testing, and production-quality processes.

capabilities.label: Motor vehicle parts manufacturing
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to manufacture components, subsystems, and replacement parts intended for integration into or use with motor vehicles.

capabilities.label: Aerospace and defense systems manufacturing
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to manufacture, integrate, and test aircraft, spacecraft, defense platforms, or their mission-critical systems and assemblies.

capabilities.label: Rail and other transportation equipment manufacturing
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to manufacture rail vehicles and other non-road transportation equipment, systems, components, or specialized conveyances.

families.label: Computing, Semiconductor and Communications Manufacturing
families.definition: Design and production of semiconductors, computing hardware, communications equipment, electronic components, and scientific or control instruments.

capabilities.label: Semiconductor design
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to design semiconductor devices, integrated circuits, architectures, layouts, or related intellectual property for fabrication.

capabilities.label: Semiconductor fabrication
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to fabricate semiconductor wafers or devices through controlled process, cleanroom, testing, and production operations.

capabilities.label: Computer hardware manufacturing
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to manufacture and assemble computers, servers, storage devices, office computing equipment, or their principal hardware systems.

capabilities.label: Communications equipment manufacturing
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to manufacture network, wireless, routing, switching, transmission, or other communications equipment and systems.

capabilities.label: Electronic component manufacturing
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to manufacture electronic components, modules, sensors, connectors, assemblies, or related electrical equipment at production scale.

capabilities.label: Scientific and control instrument manufacturing
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to manufacture scientific, measurement, imaging, photographic, analytical, or industrial control instruments and systems.

families.label: Chemical, Pharmaceutical and Medical Manufacturing
families.definition: Production of chemicals, pharmaceuticals, medical devices, and formulated household or personal care products under controlled manufacturing systems.

capabilities.label: Chemical manufacturing
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to produce basic, intermediate, specialty, or formulated chemicals through controlled industrial processing and quality systems.

capabilities.label: Pharmaceutical manufacturing
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to manufacture pharmaceutical ingredients or finished drug products through controlled, traceable, and quality-assured production processes.

capabilities.label: Medical device and equipment manufacturing
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to design for production, manufacture, assemble, and test devices, equipment, or consumables intended for medical use.

capabilities.label: Household and personal care product manufacturing
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to formulate, manufacture, package, and quality-control household, hygiene, beauty, or personal care products.

families.label: Materials and Consumer Product Manufacturing
families.definition: Production of primary materials, building products, paper goods, furnishings, apparel, tobacco products, toys, and related consumer goods.

capabilities.label: Primary metals production
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to smelt, refine, alloy, cast, roll, or otherwise produce primary metal materials and standardized metal products.

capabilities.label: Building product manufacturing
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to manufacture structural or nonstructural products and material systems used in building and construction applications.

capabilities.label: Forest and paper product manufacturing
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to process timber, fiber, pulp, or recovered material into lumber, panels, paper, tissue, or other forest-derived products.

capabilities.label: Furniture and home equipment manufacturing
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to manufacture furniture, fixtures, household equipment, furnishings, or related durable products for residential or institutional use.

capabilities.label: Apparel and textile product manufacturing
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to produce apparel, footwear, textiles, sewn products, or related wearable and fabric-based goods at commercial scale.

capabilities.label: Tobacco product manufacturing
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to manufacture regulated tobacco or nicotine products through controlled processing, formulation, packaging, and quality systems.

capabilities.label: Toy and sporting goods manufacturing
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to manufacture toys, games, recreation equipment, fitness products, or sporting goods through controlled production operations.

families.label: Standard Industrial Equipment Manufacturing
families.definition: Production of repeatable industrial, construction, agricultural, and material-handling machinery and equipment for commercial markets.

capabilities.label: Industrial machinery manufacturing
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to manufacture standardized machinery, production equipment, engines, pumps, controls, or other industrial equipment at commercial scale.

capabilities.label: Construction and agricultural equipment manufacturing
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to manufacture construction, mining, forestry, agricultural, or grounds-maintenance machinery and major equipment systems.
